type Bool<T> = T extends `${infer B extends boolean}` ? B : 'no';
type Lit<T> = T extends `${infer B extends true | 2}` ? B : 'no';
type NumberSet<T> = T extends `n:${infer N extends 1 | 3}` ? N : 'no';
type BigNumber<T> = T extends `${infer N extends 2n | 4n}` ? N : 'no';
type Nullish<T> = T extends `${infer V extends boolean | null | undefined}` ? V : 'no';
type StringWins<T> = T extends `${infer R extends boolean | 'true'}` ? R : never;
const a: Bool<'true'> = true;
const b: Bool<'false'> = false;
const c: Bool<'False'> = 'no';
const d: Lit<'true'> = true;
const e: Lit<'2'> = 2;
const f: NumberSet<'n:3'> = 3;
const g: BigNumber<'4'> = 4n;
const h: Nullish<'null'> = null;
const i: Nullish<'undefined'> = undefined;
const j: StringWins<'true'> = 'true';
console.log(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j);
